title: Onramp Signal Checkpoint — weekly sync (customer integrations)
content:
Meeting: Onramp Signal Checkpoint — weekly sync
Date: 2029-09-17 10:30 PT (30m)
Attendees: Maya T., Liam C., Ava P., Noah B., Sophia M., (observer: Rachael - customer success)
Absentees: Carl (infra)

TL;DR:
- Sprint velocity steady; two mid-priority customer integrations (AstraEdge, NimbusPay) are green but have small infra/security blockers. ParallelCare stalled on KMS + audit logs (high risk).
- Action items assigned below; escalate ParallelCare to SRE and Security this week.

Agenda items covered:
1) Quick status by customer (5m each)
2) Blockers and escalation decisions
3) Short runway and rollback/fallback decisions for scheduled onramp cutover
4) Action items and owners

Customer updates (brief):
- AstraEdge (SaaS analytics):
  - Current milestone: feature flag rollout for private embeddings; smoke test OK for <1k req/day.
  - Recent work: schema mapping for user metadata + tokenization sanity checks completed by SE.
  - Blockers: intermittent 502s from edge LB during long-tail load tests (noticed 2029-09-15). Likely NLB sticky session misconfig; infra ticket JIRA-9237 opened.
  - Risk: medium (customer can accept phased rollout).
  - Next: run 6-hour soak on staging with increased concurrency (owner Liam C., due 2029-09-19).

- NimbusPay (payments platform):
  - Current milestone: final validation of PCI-adjacent network segmentation for Redwood Private.
  - Recent work: completed KubeNetworkPolicy templates and infra preflight script.
  - Blockers: customer security team requested HSM-backed key wrapping for a subset of tokens — product question: do we require HSM for this integration or can we offer KMS with audited access?
  - Risk: low/medium (scheduling for dedicated HSM review).
  - Next: schedule 1:1 with Nimbus security (owner Ava P., due 2029-09-21).

- ParallelCare (regulated healthcare):
  - Current milestone: final acceptance tests for Private deployment + audit log retention policy.
  - Recent work: onboarding scripts run; E2E tests fail when audit log sink is enabled (error: write timeout to S3-like endpoint).
  - Blockers: KMS integration with customer's HSM provider (vendor-specific PKCS11) causing token unwrap failures in our deploy harness; also audit sink timeouts.
  - Risk: high (client contract mentions audit retention SLA).
  - Immediate ask: escalate to Security and Platform (Carl) for PKCS11 debugging and to SRE for the sink write-timeouts.
  - Next: deep-dive scheduled 2029-09-18 09:00 PT (owners: Maya T. + Carl, deliverable: repro steps and minimal repro artifact).

Cross-customer signals / platform notes:
- Observability: Console trace sampling needs temporary increase for the next 48h to capture KV cache warmup patterns observed in AstraEdge soak. (Owner: Sophia M. to enable and monitor. ETA 24h)
- Runtime perf: small perf regression in quantized 8-bit path after PR #2678 merged; appears only under long-sequence workloads. Investigation ongoing (eng-serving-runtime). Risk: could affect cost SLOs for large-batch customers. (Linked PR in artifacts)
- Capacity: Dedicated pool assignment for NimbusPay earmarked in capacity plan; billing team notified for reserved commit approval next week.

Blocker log (actionable escalations):
- ParallelCare: PKCS11 token unwrap failures (high) — escalate Security & Platform. JIRA-9471 created. Owner: Maya T. -> escalate now.
- AstraEdge: LB 502s during soak (medium) — infra ticket JIRA-9237. Owner: Liam C. -> follow-up with Carl.
- Runtime PR regression: potential perf impact (medium) — engineering triage (owner: Noah B.).

Open action items (short list):
- Maya: Prepare repro bundle for ParallelCare KMS failure; attach logs, PKCS11 config, and minimal deploy manifest. Due 2029-09-18 EOD.
- Carl (Platform/SRE): Join 2029-09-18 09:00 PT deep-dive; triage write-timeouts to audit sink; check S3 proxy metrics. Due immediate.
- Liam: Run AstraEdge 6-hour soak with concurrency ramp; report at next sync. Due 2029-09-19.
- Ava: 1:1 w/ NimbusPay security to align on HSM vs KMS requirement; capture acceptance criteria for deployment. Due 2029-09-21.
- Sophia: Temporarily increase trace sampling and dashboard retention for embedding onramp traces; keep sampling elevated 48h and post findings. Due 2029-09-18.
- Noah: Triage runtime perf regression (PR #2678); isolate workload that reproduces 15% token latency increase. Due 2029-09-19.

Notes-to-self / loose threads:
- Consider adding small canary for audit-sink writes that uses backoff + local buffering (engineering idea noted by Noah). Could reduce flakiness while SRE root-causes the timeout.
- Need clearer handoff doc update: runbook for "KMS vendor PKCS11 integration" — current Confluence page CONF-3387-onramp-runbook needs an appendix. (Owner: Maya, add appendix 2029-09-22)

Decisions made in this sync:
- ParallelCare: escalate immediately; pause any wider rollout until audit sink reliability >99.9% for 24h in staging.
- AstraEdge: proceed with phased rollout after soak if soak passes; no rollback plan required for phase-1 (low blast radius).

Risks & mitigation summary (short):
- High: ParallelCare audit/KMS — mitigation: SRE + Security deep-dive; consider temporary log buffering.
- Medium: Runtime perf regression — mitigation: revert PR if isolation reproduces on staging; coordinate with Optimize team for quantization fallback.
- Low: NimbusPay HSM ask — mitigation: product/security decision; plan for either HSM onboarding or formal KMS attestation.

Meeting adjourned. Next sync: 2029-09-24 10:30 PT (30m) — tentative focus: post-deep-dive status, soak reports, and any rollback decisions.

Quick retrospective note: sync cadence still feels tight for multi-team escalations; propose 1x longer deep-dive slot when multiple SRE/Security owners required. (flag for product-ops)

---
Raw log snippets (copied into doc to preserve context):
- "audit sink write error: PutObject timeout after 30s; retries exhausted" (ParallelCare-staging logs 2029-09-16 21:44)
- "PKCS11: CKR_GENERAL_ERROR during C_Decrypt in unwrap flow" (PKCS11 vendor debug output)
- "NLB: 502 spikes coincident with backend recycle 2029-09-15 03:18"

If you can't make next sync, post updates to: #se-proservices-onramp and add notes to this doc.


(End of notes)
